# Supplementary third-party license texts

These are verbatim upstream notices, not Gravewright license grants. See the [English inventory](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) or [inventário em português](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.pt-BR.md) for scope, exact versions and notices already retained next to bundled assets.

[SOURCES.json](SOURCES.json) records the package, version, source and SHA-256 for each copied notice. Python copies came from installed distributions matching `uv.lock`, except `tzdata` and `u-msgpack-python`, whose locked wheels were hash-verified and read without installation. JavaScript copies came from the matching installed npm packages or the versioned upstream URLs recorded in that file. File contents and upstream copyright statements are unchanged.

Estes textos reproduzem avisos upstream sem alterações; não concedem licenças em nome do Gravewright. O inventário em português explica a cobertura e as versões. `SOURCES.json` registra pacote, versão, origem e SHA-256 de cada cópia. Os textos das licenças continuam no idioma original.
